title: Gone Are the Shades of Night
description: Gone Are the Shades of Night in Tonic Solfa to QUAM DILECTA, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Latin hymns of the early Church for Hymns of the Early Church (London, 1896), headed “Wednesday Morning”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Sixes (6.6.6.6), and this page sets them to QUAM DILECTA; any other Sixes tune fits them as well.
underlay: Gone are the shades of night, The hours of rest are o’er; New beau-ties spark-le bright, And heaven is light once more.

lines: Gone are the shades of night,
The hours of rest are o’er;
And heaven is light once more.
To Thee our prayers shall speed,
Hear us, O Christ the Son,
Now, and till life is done.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns of the Early Church (1896)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Latin, public domain, as printed in Hymns of the Early Church; set to QUAM DILECTA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
